verdict: Paid channels are not yet live; Google Business Profile is your only active source.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid advertising ran — zero spend on Meta or Google Ads — because the pre-launch steps required to go live have not yet been completed. Your Google Business Profile was the sole source of engagement, delivering 81 total actions (16 calls, 26 direction requests, 39 website clicks) in the period. That said, GBP activity dropped 56% in the most recent 7 days versus the 7 days before, with the last two days recording no actions at all — a trend we are watching closely. Clearing the remaining launch blockers is the immediate priority so paid search and Meta can go live and begin driving leads directly.
